tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a push notification, email, or SMS via the OneSignal API. TIER 3 — HIGH IMPACT: confirmation is required before sending. Rate limited to 10 requests per minute. The `filters` array is limited to 200 entries; max 20,000 users per call. For push: set `contents`. For email: set `email_subject` + `email_body` (or use `template_id`). For SMS: set `contents` + `target_channel = "sms"`.

params.name: ttl
params.description: Time-to-live in seconds. Notification expires if not delivered within this window. Push only.

params.name: url
params.description: URL to open when the push notification is clicked.

params.name: data
params.description: Custom data payload passed through to the app (key-value map). Push only.

params.name: name
params.description: An internal name to help organize messages. Not shown to recipients. Max 128 chars.

params.name: extra
params.description: Additional less-common notification fields (e.g. `big_picture`, `ios_sound`, `buttons`, `web_buttons`, `android_channel_id`, `ios_category`, `collapse_id`).

params.name: app_id
params.description: OneSignal app ID.

params.name: filters
params.description: Audience filters. Maximum 200 entries. Mutually exclusive with `included_segments`.

params.name: contents
params.description: Notification content map (language code → message). E.g. `{"en": "Hello!"}`. Required for push and SMS. Not required for email (use `email_body` instead).

params.name: email_to
params.description: Send email to specific addresses (up to 20,000). Creates new subscriptions if needed. Mutually exclusive with `filters`, `included_segments`, `include_aliases`.

params.name: headings
params.description: Notification heading map (language code → heading). Push only.

params.name: sms_from
params.description: The phone number or messaging service used to send SMS/MMS. Defaults to your SMS Setup.

params.name: email_bcc
params.description: BCC recipients to copy on the email. Supplemental to the primary recipients (`email_to`, segments, aliases) — does not target on its own.
